raw_response: AI visibility for local businesses refers to how easily local consumers can discover and trust a business through AI-driven tools and platforms, including voice assistants, AI-powered search results, chatbots, and AI-generated answers. It combines presence in AI search results, accurate structured data, and authoritative signals that influence how AI systems cite and present a local business.
